description: This file defines a React functional component named CloudBackupProvider that handles cloud backup provider integrations within a web application. It manages state for authentication, backup settings, and user interactions such as enabling, disabling, and triggering backups for different cloud providers (Dropbox, Google Drive, OneDrive). The component interacts with application settings and alert services, and provides UI elements for user actions and authentication flow.

methods.name: CloudBackupProvider
methods.description: React functional component handling cloud backup provider integrations, including authentication, backup triggering, and enabling/disabling cloud backups.

methods.name: getCloudProviderIntegrationTokenFromUrl
methods.description: Extracts the cloud provider-specific token from a given URL search parameters.

methods.name: handleKeyPress
methods.description: Handles user pressing Enter in the confirmation input, decrypts and processes the confirmation code.

methods.name: handleChange
methods.description: Updates the confirmation state based on user input.

methods.name: getIntegrationStatus
methods.description: Fetches current backup frequency setting to update component state.
